# NumberInput

## NumberInput

The number field composes the shared field anatomy and two trailing
steppers, one decrement and one increment, each an action seat under the
theme's `anatomy.field_action` choice with an invisible press target that
expands outward, never inward onto its neighbor. Two rule dividers stand
with the steppers: the start line draws only while the field is invalid,
the center line stays unless a stepper is hovered or focused.

### Semantics

The input carries the `spinbutton` role with the finite number, the `min`
and the `max` as its aria value triplet; editing text stays verbatim
(`onChangeText` reports every keystroke, `onChange` reports only a finite
parse or the permitted empty string), so a partial entry like `1.` or `-`
is never rewritten mid-edit. The steppers carry `tabIndex -1`, as the
primary keeps them out of the ordinary tab order while leaving
programmatic focus possible.

### Step consistency

The primary reference's manual zero shortcut steps by one even when a
different `step` is declared, while its numeric keyboard honors `step`;
this library follows the declared `step` for both methods - one rule, no
special case (source `NumberInput.handleStep`'s raw `+/-1` branch).

### Decisions

- **No custom steppers.** The second reference has no custom steppers, so their geometry is a Superloom decision - the roster's `superloom_decision` flag.

### Uncarried variants

`readOnly`, `warn`/`warnText`, `light` (deprecated upstream, `surface` is
this library's answer), `inline`, `fluid`, `iconDescription` (the action
labels are `decrementLabel`/`incrementLabel`), `type='text'` text mode,
`locale`/`formatOptions`/`stepStartValue`/`pattern`/`validate`
(localized formatting is out of scope; the field keeps raw text),
`disableWheel`, `onClick`/`onStepperBlur` (callback surface kept to the
declared set), `decorator`/`slug` (product chrome), `hideLabel` (the label
is omitted by passing `accessibilityLabel` instead, as every field row).

### NumberInputSkeleton

Composes the field skeleton at the number field's minimum width; the
second system has no skeleton, so its values are a Superloom decision -
the roster's `superloom_decision` flag.

## NumberInput

NumberInput edits numeric text with bounded step actions; the second reference has no custom steppers, so their geometry is a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | `anatomy.label`, `anatomy.field_action`, `feedback.field` |
| Behaviors | `controllable-state`, `press` |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | no | Visible label; it names the field. Without it, pass `accessibilityLabel`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | no | Hint shown in the empty field. Under a floating label it shows once the label has risen. |
| `value` | `string or number` | no | Controlled editing text. Absent: the field keeps its own text, starting at `defaultValue` or `0`. |
| `defaultValue` | `string or number` | no | Initial uncontrolled text; applied once. |
| `onChangeText` | `function` | no | Called with the next editing text on every change; keeps partial input verbatim. |
| `onChange` | `function` | no | Called with the parsed finite number, or the empty string when `allowEmpty` permits an empty field. |
| `min` | `number` | no | Lower bound; a typed value below it marks the field invalid and steps clamp to it. |
| `max` | `number` | no | Upper bound; a typed value above it marks the field invalid and steps clamp to it. |
| `step` | `number` | no | The amount the steppers and arrow keys move by. Default `1`. |
| `allowEmpty` | `boolean` | no | Permits an empty field; the empty edit reports the empty string through `onChange` instead of `0`. |
| `hideSteppers` | `boolean` | no | Hides the decrement and increment actions. |
| `decrementLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name of the decrement action. Default `Decrement number`. |
| `incrementLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name of the increment action. Default `Increment number`. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Makes the field read-only, draws the disabled colors and announces it as disabled. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | no | Draws the error border and icon, shows `invalidText` and announces the field as invalid. |
| `invalidText` | `string` | no | Message shown below while `invalid`. |
| `helperText` | `string` | no | Message shown below while not `invalid`. |
| `surface` | `string` | no | Color leaf of the surface the field sits on; a floating label occludes the border with it. Default: config `FIELD_SURFACE`, else `background`. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name when there is no visible label. |
| `onFocus` | `function` | no | Called when the input gains focus. |
| `onBlur` | `function` | no | Called when the input loses focus. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the input. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `height` | `control.field_height` |
| `heightSmall` | `size.size_small` |
| `heightLarge` | `size.size_large` |
| `radius` | `control.field_radius` |
| `minWidth` | `control.number_input_min_width` |
| `iconSize` | `control.field_icon_size` |
| `actionInset` | `control.field_action_inset` |
| `actionSize` | `control.field_action_size` |
| `actionGap` | `control.field_action_gap` |
| `squareRadius` | `shape.radius_00` |
| `roundRadius` | `shape.radius_max` |
| `dividerHeight` | `control.number_input_divider_height` |
| `dividerWidth` | `border.width_01` |
| `ruleWidth` | `border.width_01` |
| `reserveGap` | `spacing.spacing_05` |

Color leaves accepted: `background`, `layer_01`, `layer_02`, `layer_03`.

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2}` |
| helper | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2,"helperText":"Pick a count"}` |
| invalid | `{"label":"Quantity","value":99,"max":10,"invalidText":"Choose 10 or fewer"}` |
| disabled | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2,"disabled":true}` |
| small | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2,"size":"sm"}` |
| large | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2,"size":"lg"}` |
| empty | `{"label":"Quantity","allowEmpty":true,"value":""}` |
| no steppers | `{"label":"Quantity","value":2,"hideSteppers":true}` |
